name: Stiro
summary: An in-app AI onboarding and customer-success agent for SaaS: users ask in plain words and it clicks, types and navigates your real interface for them, leaving the final click to the user.
description: An in-app AI onboarding and customer-success agent for SaaS: users ask in plain words and it clicks, types and navigates your real interface for them, leaving the final click to the user.

pricing.details: Developer free (50 runs/month, localhost and staging only). Starter 133 €/month (2,000 tasks, 1 production app); Growth 534 €/month (10,000 tasks, 3 apps); Enterprise from 21,402 €/year. Failed runs are free.
pricing.label: Freemium

features: In-app onboarding and customer-success agent for SaaS
One script tag, nothing to train or record
Leaves the final click to the user on actions that send, spend or delete
Escalates stuck requests to your team
Pay per completed task; failed runs free

howToUse.title: Create an account on stiro.ai, list your domains, paste the script tag into your app...
howToUse.description: Create an account on stiro.ai, list your domains, paste the script tag into your app layout, test on staging with the free Developer plan, then move to Starter for production.
